text: Binary per-row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): 1 if at least one comment itself draws an analogy, comparing the issue under debate to a different, familiar, everyday or commonly understood scenario (common situation, activity, well-known comparison) to make its point; 0 if the list is valid and no comment does (literal discussion of the topic, or merely citing real examples of the same issue, is not an analogy). Quoted OP text alone doesn't count; the analogy must be the commenter's own argument. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution text, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is neither an announcement nor an analogy by itself. Uses current text, no timing inferred. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null.
